readability_policy.state_changes: mark actual working-Life/start/direction changes at known K; not trading signals
readability_policy.storage_changes: retain in hover; never label every working address as a new market process
readability_policy.rhythm_detail: show actual waiting, current interval median, local-start and last-update when selected
readability_policy.empty_region: outside formal coverage is not zero, immature, or a market gap

evolution.x: formal evaluation/knowledge UTI mapped by the bound Calendar
evolution.source: ordered formal occurrences and their own origins/revisions/bases
evolution.completed_hold: horizontal intervals only across verified covered state; no linear interpolation
evolution.same_value_new_members: retain a point/identity change even when the numeric value is unchanged
evolution.working: observed prefixes only; new Life, missing input or failure breaks the trace
evolution.late_revision: show at its actual known time; never overwrite the prior as-known trace
evolution.single_snapshot: insufficient for a historical curve; draw only its observed point

selected_cut.read: read_at_knowledge(explicit_node_life, K), or its exact normally resolved equivalent
selected_cut.membership: only members and revisions eligible at K; not terminal-window backfill
selected_cut.geometry: actual process endpoints on price; confirmation markers at confirmation-time price
selected_cut.cut_limit: no price or working prefix beyond K in the selected-cut page
selected_cut.later_revision_comparison: separate labelled view with its own K and exact, never merged silently

time_policy.bar_time: HistoricalInputUTI/open_uti with same-bar close; NOT live opening knowledge certification
time_policy.units: CalendarUTITick retained; no automatic conversion to seconds or bar count
time_policy.missing: break numeric geometry; preserve present/knownness/applicability/reason and show a gap notice
time_policy.zero: a present, applicable zero stays numeric zero; missing values never become zero

required_badges: working direction/completion at selected K or LAST occurrence
configuration.disclosure: 选择时点回看不等于当时已经知道后来确认的端点；效率不是收益或胜率。

meta.formal_entry: Sparse pinned knowledge-cut exports; NOT continuous occurrence history
